MKACTORS.OpenHint: Open a searchable gallery of Actor documents that can be dragged onto a Scene.
MKACTORS.IncludeWorldActorsHint: Show Actors stored in the current world's Actors Directory.
MKACTORS.IncludeCompendiumActorsHint: Show Actors stored in visible Actor compendiums.
MKACTORS.ActorTypesHint: Comma-separated Actor type IDs to include, such as npc, monster, creature. Leave empty to include all Actor types.
MKACTORS.ExcludedActorTypesHint: Comma-separated Actor type IDs to exclude. Default excludes common player-character types.
MKACTORS.ShowOnlyVisiblePacksHint: Hide compendiums the current user cannot see.
MKACTORS.CardSizeHint: Controls the minimum width of each gallery card.
MKACTORS.SyncPortraitToTokenImageHint: When an Actor portrait changes, also set that Actor's prototype token image to the same image.
MKACTORS.DebugModeHint: Log MK Actors settings changes, UI actions, hooks, and Foundry document calls to the browser console.
MKACTORS.Search: Search by name, type, or source...
MKACTORS.DragHint: Drag this card onto the scene to create a token.
MKACTORS.CardHint: Drag this card onto the scene, double-click to open its sheet, or right-click the portrait for token options.
MKACTORS.ImagePathPortraitNote: This sets the Actor portrait; the token image path is synced automatically.
MKACTORS.FitModeHeightNote: Token dimensions are rounded to the nearest 0.5 of a grid space.
MKACTORS.ImageFitModeHint: Adjust how the image is fit to the size of the Token.
MKACTORS.AnchorHint: The default anchor (0.5, 0.5) is the center of the Token image.
MKACTORS.NoActors: No Actors matched the current filters.
MKACTORS.LoadingFailed: MK Actors | Failed to load some Actor sources. Check the console for details.
MKACTORS.CannotResolveActor: MK Actors | Could not resolve that Actor.
MKACTORS.SceneRequired: MK Actors | Open a Scene before spawning an Actor.
MKACTORS.GMRequired: MK Actors | You need GM permissions to spawn Actors directly. Drag-and-drop may still work if your permissions allow it.
